q: How old must you be according to Danish law to marry without any special permission?
appeared: It appeared in the June 2020 exam.

da.q: Hvor gammel skal man ifølge dansk lov være for at blive gift uden nogen særlig tilladelse?

learn.text: When children become 18 years old and thereby of age, they can freely choose how they want to live their lives and with whom.

q: Does a homosexual couple have the right to enter into a marriage?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2020 and May 2023 exams.

da.q: Har et homoseksuelt par ret til at indgå ægteskab?

learn.text: But in 1989 Denmark became the first country in the world to give two persons of the same sex the right to enter into a registered partnership, which has largely the same legal effects as a marriage. Persons of the same sex have since 2012 been able to marry, including to be married in the national church.

q: When did persons of the same sex get the right to marry?
appeared: It appeared in the June 2021 exam.

da.q: Hvornår fik personer af samme køn ret til at indgå ægteskab?

learn.text: But in 1989 Denmark became the first country in the world to give two persons of the same sex the right to enter into a registered partnership, which has largely the same legal effects as a marriage. Persons of the same sex have since 2012 been able to marry, including to be married in the national church.

q: In which year did persons of the same sex get the right to enter into a registered partnership?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2025 exam.

da.q: Hvilket år fik personer af samme køn ret til at indgå et registreret partnerskab?

learn.text: But in 1989 Denmark became the first country in the world to give two persons of the same sex the right to enter into a registered partnership, which has largely the same legal effects as a marriage.

q: According to Danish law, can a married couple be divorced even if one party does not want it?
appeared: It appeared in the June 2021 and November 2023 exams.

da.q: Kan et ægtepar ifølge dansk lov blive skilt, selvom den ene part ikke ønsker det?

learn.text: So divorce is possible even if the other spouse does not want it: the answer to "can a couple be divorced if one party refuses" is yes.

q: Who normally has parental authority when a father and a mother who are married to each other have a joint child?
appeared: It appeared in the June 2022 exam.

da.q: Hvem har som udgangspunkt forældremyndigheden, når en far og en mor, der er gift med hinanden, har et fælles barn?

learn.text: In a marriage the mother and father have joint parental authority, fælles forældremyndighed, over their joint children. The exams also ask about parents who live together: the starting point is that the father and the mother have it together.

q: Who has parental authority as a starting point when a mother and father who live together have a joint child?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2020 exam.

da.q: Hvem har som udgangspunkt forældremyndigheden, når en mor og far, der bor sammen, har et fælles barn?

learn.text: In a marriage the mother and father have joint parental authority, fælles forældremyndighed, over their joint children. The exams also ask about parents who live together: the starting point is that the father and the mother have it together.

q: Can you go to prison if you illegally force someone to enter into a marriage?
appeared: It appeared in the May 2024 exam.

da.q: Kan man komme i fængsel, hvis man ulovligt tvinger nogen til at indgå et ægteskab?

learn.text: It is therefore punishable, strafbart, to try to force someone to enter into a marriage that they do not themselves want. Forced marriage, tvangsægteskab, can lead to prison, fængsel.
